summary: stdcall helper that packs four int arguments into a float vector, runs 2D line-rect clipping against it, and only when the clip reports a hit converts the clipped vector back to ints. Vector slots [0]=a1, [1]=a2, [2]=0, [3]=a3, [4]=a4, [5]=0 are filled, then F_2DLineRectClipping(a6, v7) runs; if its byte result is non-zero the function returns FloatToIntConversionChain(v7, a5), otherwise it returns the clip result unchanged. Called from several UI rectangle-drawing helpers.

local_names.a1: first int source packed into vector slot 0
local_names.a2: second int source packed into vector slot 1
local_names.a3: third int source packed into vector slot 3
local_names.a4: fourth int source packed into vector slot 4
local_names.a6: clipping rectangle/region argument forwarded to F_2DLineRectClipping
local_names.v7: local 8-float buffer carrying the packed source vector and the clip result

operations.description: Local float vector v7 initialized as v7[0]=(float)a1, v7[1]=(float)a2, v7[2]=0.0, v7[3]=(float)a3, v7[4]=(float)a4, v7[5]=0.0
F_2DLineRectClipping invoked with a6 and the packed vector v7; its result is kept as the branch condition
When the low byte of the clip result is non-zero the function takes the conversion branch, otherwise it falls through to return the clip result
FloatToIntConversionChain invoked with v7 and a5, converting the clipped vector back to integer coordinates; its return value is returned directly
Returns the FloatToIntConversionChain result when the clip hit, otherwise returns the clip result itself

Invoked by UI rectangle-drawing helpers UICursorSelectionRectangleRenderWithInterpolatio (0045B660), ConditionalDraw (00475C80), F_2DRectangleDrawingWithOutline (00475D90) and RectangleDrawingWithPattern (004972B0)

unresolved: The roles of a5 and a6 (only forwarded, never consumed in this function) are unknown
